author: shad
name: Giveaways
short: Interactive giveaway builder with timers, edits, cancels, and rerolls.
description: Create giveaways with an interactive button/modal builder (similar to EmbedCreator), or skip it with flags. Features persistent enter/leave buttons, chunked timers that survive reloads, cancel/end/edit/reroll, role requirements, bonus tickets, account/server age gates, and Red Permissions cog compatible checks.
install_msg: Thanks for installing Giveaways by shad. Load with `[p]load giveaways`, then run `[p]giveaway`. That opens a private popup form, then a private editor. Setup prompts delete themselves.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores Discord user IDs of giveaway hosts and entrants, along with ticket counts, until the giveaway is cleaned up. No other personal data is stored.
